role: PlanetryItems: configurable custom items, rarity glyphs, lore, Minecraft attributes, oxygen, equipment, durability and level/skill requirements.
platform: Paper/Purpur backend plugin, not Velocity, Spigot or Folia.
compatibility: Paper/Purpur26.1.2, Java25, paper-api26.1.2.build.74-stable. No database. All participating backends must share item definitions and language files; persistent item data survives normal item serialization. Optional AuraSkills2.4.0 API, Nexo1.22+ for26.1.2, and PlanetryCore cachedProgress(UUID). Real Nexo/client/Purpur combination requires staging. Optional PlanetryItems-Velocity sync protocol2 centralizes definitions/lang; definitions-source defaults local and requires restart to change.
integration: Optional Nexo copies appearance without source updater identity and renders native glyph/shift arguments with player-aware permissions and configurable fallbacks; current/global and older player resolver APIs are supported. Optional AuraSkills supplies five skill requirements and nonpersistent active-equipment bonuses. PlanetryCore levels use cachedProgress, never vanilla XP; missing/unloaded sources deny positive requirements. Installed disabled/incompatible NetworkInventorySync denies mutation until isReady(UUID). ItemService/PDC preserve item identity, remaining durability, oxygen and saved boolean policy. Local definitions load recursively from items/ with one-time legacy root import; both catalog/lang validate atomically. Admin permission planetry.admin.items, /pitems info displays settings. Public /migrate has durable per-backend two-hour cooldown; join/reload migration waits readiness and preserves quantities/durability/foreign PDC/enchantments. Local removed IDs are removed with notices. Restricted items remain holdable but unusable, with requirements in messages rather than lore. Lore order type/flavour/attributes/rarity/durability; all templates configurable in lang.yml. Durability uses native proportional bars where available plus current/max lore, red only at or below30%; native bundle fullness retains its own bar. Custom counters govern accepted action completion; air/block/entity input clicks do not spend points, ordinary native wear/mending/repair cannot rewrite counters. Equipment checks honor configured wearable type/slot, including restored inventories and alternate event routes. Policy canplace/soulbound short and planetry- aliases work at root or bonuses, strictly boolean and unique; soulbound suffix configurable. Saved policy protects items missing their definition. Nested carriers, offhand/ammunition, bundle/ender routes, drops, death and full-storage equipment enforce soulbound. Durable cursor escrow preserves exact stacks across close/quit/death/readiness/capacity failures and retains unreadable recovery data. Drop confirmation bypass is temporary, session/permission/stack-fenced and cleared on reload. Main-thread networkItemIds(String) yields immutable sorted prefix completions capped100; giveNetworkItem(UUID,String,int) returns bounded atomic-grant results with readiness/session/catalog/inventory rechecks. Uncertain writes must never be retried automatically; postcommit notification/reconcile failures do not undo delivery. PlanetryVelocity bridge requires its matched Items API and private authenticated channel. Optional definitions-source proxy uses PlanetryItems-Velocity protocol2 on planetry:items_sync with shared private key, nonce/HMAC24K chunks and paired snapshot<=2MB. Backends poll5s with player carrier, fully validate and forced-atomically cache before no-throw activation; failures/restarts retain lastgood. Empty servers catch up on firstconnection; no-cache readiness prevents empty-catalog mutation with no local fallback. Config/integrations stay local; source/key changes restart-only. Unknown IDs in proxy mode are preserved unavailable with native attributes suspended, protecting transfers ahead of definitions; retirements never delete by lag inference. Check proxy /piv status for matching applied revisions. No live installation is automated. Durable proxy generations and per-item proxy_generation LONG prevent stale known-ID migrations from reducing newer durability or metadata; full-storage unknown/future equipment stays suspended in place. Back up generation.dat and generation.initialized; backends reject rollback and same-generation forks.
validation: Java25 mvn -B -ntp clean verify dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.outputFile=target/test-classpath.txt. Run python3 scripts/smoke.py target/planetry-items-VERSION.jar, then --without-hooks. Real pinned Paper26.1.2 with controlled players and optional API fixtures covers actual ItemStacks, serialization, requirements, metadata, attributes, durability/action completion/native bars, equipment/placement/soulbound policies, cursor recovery, migrations, glyph resolution and network grants. Unit tests cover recursive/legacy files, strict schema/aliases/ranges, text safety, actual Paper attribute constants, API adapters and atomic deep-copy grants. Cross-repository bridge smoke with --items-jar tests actual reflected networkItemIds/giveNetworkItem APIs and readiness/capacity/session/catalog fences; controlled sessions do not establish connected-client transport. Issue22 adds signed bounded protocol/assembly, polling/nonces/session/timeouts and forced atomic-cache corruption/failure tests. python3 scripts/sync-smoke.py target/planetry-items-VERSION.jar runs two real Paper processes for first-sync and cachedrestart, >32KiB multipart pair activation, invalid material/language/render rejection, auth/carrier/nonce/deadline/replay fences, no local fallback, no-cache preservation, unknown transferred-ID suspension and later migration preserving durability/foreign data. Fixtures seed only the pending transport request and inject through the registered production messenger; request generation/polling has unit coverage. Stage real clients, actual Nexo/AuraSkills/resourcepacks, Purpur, protection-plugin event ordering and real network transfers; never use production player data or install releases automatically. See docs/ACCEPTANCE.md and scripts/sync-probe/README.md for exact evidence and remaining limits. Generation regressions cover durable ordering/restart/failure, rollback/fork rejection and known-ID future item durability/full-storage equipped transfer preservation.
